title: Fall Travel Bags That Can Handle “Just One More Sweater”
summary: There's something about traveling in the fall that just feels different. The air is crisper, the colors are richer, and somehow, your packing list is a little… fluffier. Maybe it's those chunky cable knits you can't leave behind or that blanket scarf that feels like an emotional support accessory. And while you could try to be ruthless about what makes the cut, we say bring it all. The trick isn't traveling with less; it's traveling smarter. That means choosing luggage and bags that can keep you organized, handle the bulk, and still look like they belong in your travel photos. Whether you're heading for leaf-peeping drives, cabin weekends, or a whirlwind Friendsgiving, these Vera Bradley favorites will have you packing bulky sweaters without breaking a sweat. Miramar Weekender Your weekend bag should work as hard as you do. Lucky for you, the Miramar Weekender overnight bag knows how to pull its weight when you're on a brief getaway. Smart organization and carry-on compliance mean you've officially cracked the code on how to pack bulky sweaters and still zip your bag with room to spare. Toss in your boots, your favorite scarf, and yes, that extra cardigan, and you're good to go. The detachable strap and trolley sleeve keep you moving comfortably, whether you're dashing to catch a train or gliding through the airport. "Great size, comfortable and good quality. Perfect for a short weekend trip!" ~ Cara 22" Adair Spinner Perfect for those who like to travel light but stylish, the 22" Adair Spinner carry-on is all about ease in motion. Smooth-glide spinner wheels and a telescopic handle mean you're navigating airports like a pro. Compression panels inside help maximize space, so learning how to pack for cold weather feels easy (even with your chunkiest sweaters in tow). "Took it on a 5-day trip and it was perfect! Love the zipper compartment to keep everything in place!" ~ Jeannie 26" Adair Spinner For longer escapes (or when you can't decide which sweaters to leave behind), the 26" Adair Spinner suitcase offers the same sleek design and effortless maneuverability as its smaller sibling, but with extra room to play. The expandable panel is your secret weapon for spontaneous shopping finds during your fall travels. "Probably the cutest and most unique suitcase I've ever come across ... The materials are high quality, the wheels glide well, and the suitcase is a great size." ~ Payton Large Original Duffel Bag This is the duffel that says yes to last-minute plans. Roomy, lightweight, and versatile, our Large Original Duffel is ideal for tossing in chunky knits, a cozy throw, and maybe a bottle of cider for that cabin trip you have planned this fall. Three interior slip pockets keep smaller items from getting lost in the shuffle, making it a smart choice for weekend warriors who love organized chaos. "I love this bag! It's adorable, super roomy and holds everything I need for a night away from home." ~ Emily Favorite Fall Travel Accessories Jewelry Roll Your statement earrings and delicate chains deserve as much protection as your wardrobe. This Jewelry Roll keeps everything tangle-free with a luxe faux suede lining, so you can change your look from hiking trail to dinner party without a second thought. "Perfect size for travel, plenty of useable space for assorted jewelry, lovely pattern too." ~ Paula Travel Pill Case Cold-weather travel often means vitamins, supplements, or medications are in the mix. The Travel Pill Case keeps them neatly organized in a zippered case that slips right into your carry-on, proving that practicality can be pretty. "Such a pretty addition to travel with. The zippered case makes sure that pill box doesn't open during transit." ~ Patrice Woodward Small Belt Bag For days filled with apple-picking, farmers' markets, or exploring a new town, the Woodward Small Belt Bag keeps your essentials close and your hands free. Card slots, a key loop, and a zip pocket make it as functional as it is stylish. "Perfect size and plenty of room for everything I need." ~ Debbi Be Ready for Your Next Fall Escape with the Right Travel Bag Packing for cooler weather doesn't have to mean stuffing and struggling. The right bag turns how to pack for cold weather into a satisfying part of the journey—almost as fun as the trip itself. Whether you're road-tripping under golden leaves or flying cross-country for a festive gathering, these Vera Bradley travel companions are here to keep your sweaters, scarves, and sense of adventure right where they belong. Because fall is fleeting, but the right bag? That's forever. SHOP ALL TRAVEL BAGS & ACCESSORIES
